3.question: Why are my basil leaves turning yellow?
3.answer: Yellowing leaves on basil can be a sign of overwatering, underwatering, or a lack of sunlight. Ensure the soil is well-drained and the plant gets at least 6 hours of direct sun daily.

10.question: How do I stop my cilantro from bolting (flowering)?
10.answer: Cilantro bolts quickly in hot weather. To prolong the harvest of leaves, provide afternoon shade, keep the soil consistently moist, and harvest leaves regularly. Also, plant it in the cooler parts of spring and fall.
